Title: Löschung von 1*-Bewertungen eines - durch illegalen Spam beworbenen - Unternehmens
Text:
Löschungskriterien sind unklar. Trotz angemessener Wortwahl und Auszügen der Kommunikation werden Bewertungen eines Unternehmens, das einen bekannten Spamversender für seine illegalen Werbeaktivitäten nutzt, kommentarlos und ohne Reaktionsmöglichkeit gelöscht. 
Der Hinweis auf die Bewertungsregeln hilft nicht weiter, die Bewertung für ein Unternehmen mit illegal agierenden Partner kann kaum positiv ausfallen.

---- 
Nachtrag aufgrund der Antwort von Trustpilot:

- Top: schnelle Reaktion
- Fall zur Klärung eingereicht 
--> Bewertung von 1 auf 3 Sterne aktualisiert
(Update folgt ggf. nach Abschluss)

----
Zweiter Nachtrag
In einem Falle wurde die Bewertung berücksichtigt / aktiv gelasen.

In einem anderen Fall wurde auf den Versender der Mail verwiesen. Damit wäre das beworbene Unternehmen, was am Ende für den illegalen Spam bezahlt natürlich fein raus. Und den Versender (oft in UK oder Ch, damit außerhalb EU) interessiert das ungefähr so wenig, wie eine Eiche, wenn eine Wildsau die Eicheln frisst.

Title: DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME LEAVING A REVIEW.
Text:
I wouldn't bother wasting your time writing reviews on this platform. If you leave negative reviews, they will harass you for personal information so as to identify you on behalf of the company about which you have left the review (something that can only be described as a form of doxing). If the review is not liked they simply censor your view by deleting it. So, a genuine bad experience cannot be described and shared unless you have all the documentation and are willing to submit all your personal information to Trustpilot who will then forward it on to the company involved.
However, if you leave positive reviews, there is no vetting procedure, it is just taken as being okay and genuine. This leaves a huge unchecked bias to positive reviews and you could say allows companies to submit their own positive reviews as they are not checked or treated the same as negative reviews.
What is the point in spending your own valuable time contributing to this fiasco of a platform. Trustpilot you are a waste of time and I will not be submitting any future reviews. You have lost a contributor and I will discourage anyone else I can from reviewing on here, and encourage them to follow my example. Farewell.

Title: Irriterad
Text:
Jag har aldrig tidigare varit så irriterad att jag går in och lämnar ett negativt omdöme. 
Jag har varit kund hos Trustpilot många år genom mitt företag och det har fungerat bra. Tills i år när fakturan chockhöjdes av okänd anledning. Eftersom att jag inte såg mailet hann jag heller inte avbeställa innan betänketiden gick ut och åkte på ett år till med en kostnad på ca 30 000 kr om året. Detta blir vårat sista år med trustpilot.  
Dessutom råkade vi betala en faktura dubbelt och det visar sig väldigt svårt att få tillbaka pengarna. När vi till slut skickat in alla uppgifter de begärt så slutar de svara på vår kontakt och har inte svarat på flera veckor nu trots upprepade försök från oss att få kontakt med dem. Chattade till slut även med trustpilot (som inte verkar gå att ringa) och fick till svar att de lovade att kontakta vår kontaktperson i Sverige angående detta och be honom svara mig då han inte svarat på flera månader (sedan jag blev irriterad över chockhöjningen) 
Han har fortfarande inte svarat och personen vi skickade all info om den dubbla betalningen till svarar som sagt inte heller. Vet inte längre var jag ska vända mig då ingen återkopplar. Under all kritik!

Title: Jeg er blevet snigmyrdet på Trustpilot
Text:
Jeg er blevet snigmyrdet på Trustpilot, se svar på seneste anmeldelse af byggefolk.dk
Det kan ikke passe at Trustpilot ikke er vidende om at de 169 anmeldelser som han har lavet ikke er betalt arbejde. Han bekræfter det indtil flere gange i det jeg har fremlagt som svar.
Som det også fremgår, har han brugt en enstjernet anmeldelse til ren afpresning.
Tænker med gru på alle de andre "The kunder" der har en lukrativ forretning ved at bruge Trustpilot som afpresning. Et er jo alle de penge han har fået for de 169 anmeldelser, noget andet er alle de penge han har presset ud af sagesløse mennesker for ikke at lave en enstjernet anmeldelse. 
Jeg har skrevet til jer men har intet hørt, derfor denne enstjernede anmeldelse, som dog nemt kan laves om til en 5 stjernet hvis I kan få fingeren ud. For jeres produkt og platform elsker jeg, og det er ikke et slet skjult forsøg på smiger, jeg mener det. Og at det er en åben platform gør jo at der er frit slag for lykkeriddere, I skal bare reagerer prompte når en af disse afpressere afsløres, og se på hvor stort problemets omfang egentlig er.
En anden ting jeg undrer mig over er hvorledes de 5 dårlige anmeldelser af Mobilspa.dk pludseligt forsvinder?

Tutto questo rende questo sito meritevole della valutazione massima poichè mi rendo conto che francamente non avrei alcun "suggerimento" per migliorare l'esperienza col sito stesso. Posso solo dire grazie a tutto lo staff che lavora dietro le quinte per agevolare acquirenti, opinionisti e aziende che possono così avere una buona vetrina e un confronto diretto grazie ai molti feedback ricevuti.

Title: Jeg er dybt frustreret over Trustpilots…
Text:
Jeg er dybt frustreret over Trustpilots arbejdsmetoder. - Vi er en lille virksomhed, som for år tilbage bad vores kunder give os en bedømmelse på trustpilot, hvilket mange kunder gjorde. - Efter flere år hvor vores kunder bedømte os uden at vi betalte noget til trustpilot, blev vi kontaktet af jer, og spurgt om vi ikke gerne ville vise de fine anmeldelser på vores website mv. - Det kostede selvfølgelig noget, men det var en fair pris.... MEN i de senere år har trustpilot/I virkelig skruet op for jeres priser. -Således at vi i 2020 skulle betale kr. 20500 til trustpilot, i 2021 steg dette med 22 % så vi skulle betale kr. 25020 og sandelig om I ikke bare sende os en mail nu hvor I lader det stige endnu 29,4 % til kr. 32400 for næste år. - Alt dette ville jeg naturligvis gerne drøfte med trustpilot (jer) men eftersom jeg ikke kan komme i kontakt med min sælger "sandra Fernando" efter utallige telefonopkald, mails osv. ser jeg ingen anden udvej at forsøge mig her.  (Jeg har endda ringet til jeres salgsafdeling for nye kunder, som er den eneste måde at ringe ind til jer. Her talte jeg med en sød mand, som sagde at Sandra sad tæt på ham, og han skulle nok få hende til at kontakte mig) - Nu forsøger jeg via denne kommentar at råbe jer op. - Hvis dette heller ikke lykkes, så må jeg jo gå videre med det til min bekendte som er journalist ved TV2.
Med venlig hilsen

Title: The whole point of Trustpilot is to…
Text:
The whole point of Trustpilot is to enable customers that have had a bad experience to share that with others.
But Trustpliot also make it very easy for a company to challenge and remove every bad review. The irony is that decent companies allow bad reviews to remain, the really bad companies challenge every bad review which ends up totally defeating the point of trustpilot.
Since it is the companies that pay Trustpilot, not the individul reviewers, the moral hazard is that Trustpilot makes it far easier for companies to remove negative reviews than individuals to maintain them.

The upshot is that Trustpilot is undermining its value to individuals and has no future. Maybe that is why the share price in tanking.

If someone from Trustpilot wishes to reply to my post, I would be very grateful if you could let me know what percentage of reviews that companies flag remain on the site. My guess is that it is very low.

Title: Trust restored
Text:
I regularly used trustpilot until today. I posted several reviews about a terrible online company who sell garden plants; finally one cut through to the company and they asked to verify my identity; first I had an invitation from them to send my details, including email and phone number, which I returned but declined to give personal details. I'd had such a bad time of it with them, as had many other reviewers, I saw no need to talk to them about my review, which was brutally honest. Then trustpilot sent me an email asking, very politely, for me to identify myself; the only documentation I have from the company are numerous emails, not using their colourful headers, but in black and white type, but very detailed, and there is in fact a logo in unique type which no fraudster could replicate.  Trustpilot wanted a 'screenshot' of such documentation, giving a link to instructions how to make such a thing, for the tech non savvy, like me. Not convinced.

If you give a bad review it is unlikely to be publisehd.
And if it is, the reviewee will suppress it.

How many testimonials do you see which say "it wasn't very good"?

I've been disappointed by the poor performance of some tradesmen and suppliers, but you never see any adverse comments on their websites.

Now, I wonder if this review of Trustpilot will be easily visible on their own website :-)

To be really useful, the poorest ratings ought to be highlighted so that we know whom to avoid.

I was recently nagged to leave a rating for a service which had no particular merit.
If I had been impressed by the service, I might have been inclined to sing their praises off my own bat.
But being told to "rate us on Trustpilot" prompted my response.

"Tell everybody how good we are!" ... expecting glowing reviews.

I will tell it as it is.

Now, if only we could give NEGATIVE feedback for the genuine rogues, it might be useful.


UPDATE

I've just had a stock reply:

"Thanks for your feedback. You can always find all of a company's reviews on their Trustpilot profile. Reviews will always be displayed in chronological order. You can review any company by searching for them in the search bar on trustpilot.com and leaving a review on their profile."

I'm now even less convinced about the usefulness of Trustpiot.

#UPDATE 13-01-2022

Zie reactie van Trustpilot: 

Trustpilot claimt een open review platform te zijn die iedereen de mogelijkheid om een profiel voor een bedrijf aan te maken. Ze claimen te geloven dat dit de beste manier is om consumenten een stem te geven, en ze een plek te geven waar ze vrij hun ervaring met een bedrijf kunnen delen.

Zo open zijn ze niet als ze bedrijven zomaar kunnen verwijderen van hun platform. Reactie van Trustpilot is een grote leugen! Betaalde klanten hebben voordelen zoals het verbergen van negatieve reviews.

------------------------------------------------

Mijn bedrijf Socialgram met over 380 reviews en een gemiddelde score van 4.7 is na 9 maanden intensief gebruik gesloten omdat het volgens Trustpilot in strijd is met hun policy. Dit terwijl crypto ponzi/scam bedrijven volop geaccepteerd worden. De legitieme ondernemer wordt neergezet als oplichter en het harde werk dat over de maanden is verricht met het verzamelen van reviews wordt zonder waarschuwing verwijderd. Ik waarschuw iedere ondernemer niet in zee te gaan met Trustpilot. Dit platform staat vol met neppe reviews & bieden geen klantenservice aan niet betaalde klanten. Het is een schande dat bedrijven zoals dit je zonder pardon kunnen verwijderen van hun platform.

Title: Good idea but unsuitble for some industries
Text:
My employers have made trustpilot reviews a major part of their day to day activities. 
They have employed staff to manage the account, spend the firm's money, time and resources on the account. They often (as knee jerk reaction) go running to staff with a bad review in hand and demand the matter be rectified in some cases the reviews are taken as a gauge of the staffs performance. This all takes time and money and causes a stress on the employees. In addition to this they request that staff invite reviews from customers. This maybe perfectly acceptable for companies selling a product or a one off service. However the industry I work in is real estate / property management, where there is an ongoing relationship with a customer for a number of years. This creates a number of issues that is deterimental to employees of subcribers firms mental health and stress levels. This detrimental affect is caused by the fact that sometimes a matter outside of the employee's or perhaps the firms control prompts a negative review and despite responding on the platform or making other inroads to resolve the query will not always mean the review is altered and much time maybe spent trying to get it changed. Negative reviews are always written in the heat of the moment and the star rating of a firm may not change even if the customer is happy with a resolution. In addition to this in my industry, by inviting a review from a cutomer (and offering a financial incentive for getting a positive review), leaves the door open for the customer(s) (who maybe, for a number of reasons - perhaps due to mental health reasons or other personal problems) may later wish to take revenge or remonstrate about a matter and leave a bad review.
I am also sceptical on the trust pilot service and platform as firms can pay to manage their account. It seems some firms have quite a high rating on trustpilot however when one factors in other platforms that provide a reviewing options and take a more holistic approach to the firms reviews on the internet the picture is quite different and the firm can often been seen in a much less positive light.
I'm sure the trustpilot endeavour was a genuine one originally but for long term real estate contracutal services that have many other factors at play (such as Landlords, other property occupiers, maintenance contractors and government legislation) the service is inappropriate for such firms. Of course the firms can chose not to use it however many have opened a door that cannot be closed. Many of my customers (uninvited) have left positive reviews about my firm from my work but I do not attach much value to these reviews being left on the internet. So my experience from trust pilot has been bad unfortunately as they do not seem to demonstrate any knowledge of the industry I operate in on their platform so as to help them obtain a quality review from a consumer whether good or bad. In addition in my opinion their headline ratings do not reflect other reviews of firms that are availabe across other internet review platforms and this can be seen in numerous consumer reviews on their platform.

The cost just to customise an invitation is a few hundred more and then to embed a decent trustpilot widget on your website that will be a few hundred a month more again! Yes you get the classic line "yes bit think of the trust you get from customers" yes but it's still gouging plain and simple. Some parts are free yes but so much of the platform for businesses is segmented, modularised, and priced that it's effectively overpriced. It's like Google charging you if you wanted to do more than 2 search terms a day - like unnecessarily charging for what others would expect to be included.

Somit ist Trustpilot für mich keine seriöse Plattform. Jedes Unternehmen kann sich so im Durchschnitt 4,5 - 5 Sterne geben. Schade eigentlich, ich werde hier nichts mehr schreiben.

Ihren Support hatte ich vor zwei Wochen bereits eine E-Mail mit detailierten Informationen gesendet. Leider habe ich bis jetzt noch keine Antwort erhalten. Wieso sollte ich jetzt nochmal Ihren Support anschreiben? Es steht doch alles in meiner Bewertung. Ändern werden Sie sicherlich nichts. In meinem Freundes- und Bekanntenkreis denkt mittlerweile jeder so. Ich gebe Ihrem Unternehmen noch 2-3 Jahre.

Jetzt ist auch Trustpilot auf die Idee gekommen auf Einladung Bewertungen abzugreifen. Ehrliche Bewertungen kommen nur freiwillig.

Title: They don’t act in the best interest of consumers who have had a negative experience.
Text:
They allow companies to manipulate positive reviews and actively remove negative reviews, even when genuine!  Major Mobiles are selling substandard iPads to the UK from the USA. I left a negative review for Major Mobiles because the iPad stoped working due to a hardware fault, which was verified by a UK Apple store.  We were having difficulty getting a refund or replacement on their so called 2 year warranty promise from Major Mobiles, we could not even get a reply from them.
We took legal action against Major Mobiles and have a CCJ against them, but because they use a forwarding address it’s impossible to get any real resolution from them.

Many people are having issues with faulty goods, products sent with plugs that are not British Standard and finding it impossible to contact or get a resolution to issues and complaints.  
We have been going through this for many months and seen countless negative reviews removed, because you have to keep providing receipts, and paperwork to prove that you are a genuine customer.  
Major Mobiles dispute they are genuine and because they pay Trustpilot for advance services, reviewers give up and they get removed.  Meanwhile Major Mobiles spam their Trustpilot account with fake positive reviews about great delivery to hide the negative reviews.
I will for one never trust TrustPilot reviews or hope to deal with them again they are terrible and are allowing people to be ripped off when the company in question pays for advanced services with them.  

They removed another one of my reviews which was also genuine. I have contacted them a number of times, provided receipts of the order and payment, I also sent the refund email, it has not been restored.  This company does not pay for their extra services.

To add insult to injury, they also allowed Major Mobiles to misuse my personal data.  I provided Trustpilot with my email address and telephone number for Major Mobiles to contact me, this was a different email that I originally used to purchase from them.  At no point until this, had I received any communication from them, after doing this, I started to receive marketing emails from Major Mobiles, but I still to date have never received any contact about my warranty claim.

I raised this immediately to Trustpilot and complained that my data had been used for purposes that I had not agreed to, this was weeks ago. I have reported both companies for this data breach. 

The response below goes no way to answering any of my questions or concerns and they don’t reply to any of my emails or requests when sent through already.

Title: Neutrales Bewertungsportal oder Firma?
Text:
Ein Bewertungsportal wo Gelder fliesen ist kein neutrales Bewertungsportal sondern eine Firma, deshalb auch diese Unmengen von gekauften Positiv-Bewertungen.

Firmen oder Shop´s die die kostenlose Version von „TRUSTPILOT“ nutzen, haben keine Chance sich gegen gekaufte Bewertungen von Konkurrenzfirmen, oder nicht gerechtfertigte Bewertungen von Kunden zu wehren. Zahlende Firmen dagegen können Negativ-Bewertungen nach belieben löschen und ihre Shopseiten bereinigen lassen.

Frei nach dem Motto: „Die Hand die mich füttert, beiße ich nicht ab“!

Wenn „TRUSTPILOT“ eine Bewertung, auf verlangen löscht und diese eventuell erst nach ca. 7 Wochen doch wieder online stellen sollte, ist diese wieder mit zig Positiv-Bewertungen überschrieben und nicht mehr aktuell, verschwindet somit im „Nirwana“.

Man stelle sich mal vor, „Trustpilot“ würde wirklich seriös und unabhängig arbeiten und gerechtfertigte Negativ-Bewertungen stehen lassen, wie viele unseriöse Firmen ihre Verträge dann mit „Trustpilot“ kündigen würden. Bei 109,00 Euro im Monat nur für das Standartpaket, welches jährlich im voraus gezahlt werden muss, wäre dieses für „TRUSTPILOT“ ein Millionenverlust und müsste Mitarbeiter entlassen bzw. dann könnte „TRUSTPILOT“ auch Bankrott anmelden.

Schon aus diesem Grund kann „TRUSTPILOT“ es sich nicht leisten seriös und unabhängig zu arbeiten, also für mich und bestimmt auch für Viele andere Bewerter eine absolut nicht vertrauenswürdiges Bewertungsportal!

Text:
We opened a Trustpilot account on 05-Jul-2021.
We are a small 15 years old company who were hoping to achieve some positive reviews to help boost our business.
We emailed all customers to let them know we had just opened a Trustpilot account and asked them if they could spare 10 minutes to leave a review.

On 11-Ju-2021 we received email from Trustpilot stating that "their automated software had removed 4 reviews for appearing suspicious or fake"!
Apparently all customers whose reviews were removed were sent an email and asked them to "prove" that, in fact, the reviews were true. 
All customers affected contacted me to let me know and subsequently sent a reply email to Trustpilot (some sending actual copy invoices from our company to prove they are actually customers) and to date 03-Aug-2021 these reviews have still not been restored on our Trustpilot page! 
We actually have some of the customer's showing on our website giving testimonials! 
No communication from Trustpilot to us or our affected customers almost a month after our customers have sent in "proof" of actually being our customers. Pretty poor if you ask me. Thinking of closing account and changing to Google Reviews instead.

Title: The reason Trustpilot stock is down 50%
Text:
I started as a Trustpilot customer in 2017. Great service, very professional sales staff. Their service was SEO-optimized to help us get review stars in Google search results, so was happy to pay the fees to enhance our business listing. I even got two of my clients to sign up.
As they had more success, they got more greedy and aggressive, pushing renewal rates higher and higher. On top of that, Google changed their algorithm to no longer display the review stars, greatly reducing the value of the enhanced services to our business. I had signed a 3 year deal in 2018, with no auto-renewal clause, so I let it expire in June 2021. 
Because they want to pump their stock price, they went after me as if I had signed a renewal contract. We are now in 2022 and they have sent debt collectors, and now attorneys threatening a lawsuit over a non-existent contract. 
Be very careful, this company isn't what it used to be. There's a reason their stock is tanking - they are now putting the squeeze on their clients to juice revenue.

Jeg har modtaget en mail fra jer, i forlængelse af, at I - efter jeres opfordring - beder mig kommentere min bedømmelse/tilfredshed med Stofa. 
I angiver, at Stofa har kommenteret min kritik af dem, og I sender en mail , hvor I skriver, at jeg kan se Stofas svar på min kritik. Det kan jeg ikke på den måde I sender Stofas svar. Men det er måske også meningen?
Så derfor må I sende Stofas bemærkninger om min kritik af Stofa og deres ledelse/ejerskab, herunder Niels Duedahl på en anden måde. 
Jeg bor få hundrede meter fra "Blålys" / Niels Duedahls hovedsæde i Esbjerg.
Stofa og det mærkelige foretagende "Trustpilot", som åbenbart skal være buffer for kundernes kritik af den elendige ledelse og kvalitet i Stofas produkter samt "Blålys", er dog det ringeste og laveste jeg har mødt i mit professionelle liv og virke som chef i den rådgivende ingeniør branche.

Hvis ikke I reagerer på denne mail, og sender Stofas svar på min kritik af dem på nedenanførte mailadresse, går jeg videre til pressen herom, og om jeres fremgangsmåde overfor os som kunder og forbrugere. Jeg har nære relationer til pressen.

Title: No Reason to Trust Pilot
Text: Following a recent and terrible experience with Randox Health, it's been fascinating to watch as they "game" Trustpilot. Over the last week, Randox Health has received a roughly 5:1 ratio of 1-star reviews, and yet their rating has remained at 2.8-stars throughout that period. In this time, the percentage of 1-star reviews has gone from 47% to 50%. At the same time, Randox Health is typically only replying to 5-star reviews (this has changed in the last 24-hours following numerous complaints). Additionally, it appears they are actively soliciting 5-star reviews to offset the obvious PR disaster they are facing. Altogether, this means Randox Health is clearly able to "game" Trustpilot. The result is, Trustpilot is no longer Trustworthy. All I need is a new email address and I can begin "gaming" Trustpilot as well. It is shocking how murky the rating business is already, but with the word "Trust" in your name, you've set a high bar, and fallen short. Put simply: I no longer trust Trustpilot.

Title: Trustpilot er på virksomhedernes side
Text:
Jeg havde en dårlig oplevelse med en virksomhed for et par år siden, og skrev defor en negativ anmeldelse herinde. Virksomheden ville sammen med Trustpilot verificere at jeg havde haft en reel kundeoplevelse, og defor indsendte jeg dokumentation herfor. Jeg handlede aldrig hos virksomheden igen, og derfor står den ene anmeldelse alene. Dokumenteret og godkendt af Trustpilot.
For nylig ville virksomheden igen verificere gyldigheden af samme anmeldelse, og sammen med Trustpilot bad de om den samme dokumentation igen. Jeg svarede at Trustpilot allerede var i besiddelse af dokumentationen, men de bad mig bruge tid på at gøre det igen. Hvis jeg ikke gjorde det, ville anmeldelsen blive fjernet, selvom den afspejler det korrekte forløb og er dokumenteret. Med andre ord kan en virksomhed via Trustpilot chikanere en kunde der har givet en dårlig anmeldelse, ved at blive med at henvende sig og bruge tid på at indsende den samme dokumentation for den samme sag igen og igen. Uanset hvad vinder virksomheden. Bliv med at bruge tid på at bevise noget du allerede har bevist, eller se din anmeldelse som fungerer som advarsel og pejlemærke for andre kunder forsvinde. Trustpilot er desværre på virksomhedernes side og ikke det uvildige organ de selv mener de er. 
*Redigeret i forhold til Trustpilot's svar*
Jeg har allerede fået en mail før denne anmeldelse blev slået op hvor der står af sagen er afsluttet, og efterfølgende er mine henvendelser er blevet ignoreret, så jeg har ikke mere at skulle have sagt selvom de skriver det.

Text:
Bedeutung!
Mehrere Dinge nicht anhand der gleichen Maßstäbe beurteilen; ungerecht, nicht neutral sein.

Wo werden also  die Fake\Bezahlten Bewertungen geprüft?

Bewerter müssen sich Verifizieren Firmen nicht.
Das gibt doch ein komplett falsches Bild der angeblichen "Offenheit" Bewertungen wieder.
Wie soll man sich als Verbraucher daran überhaupt noch orientieren?

Auf dieser Basis zweifle ich sehr an der Vertrauenswürdigkeit ihres Portals.
Deshalb auch nur  1 Stern!

Mein Vorschlag!
Entfernt  die Möglichkeit der Firmen Bewertungen auf Einladungen zu verschicken oder aber Verifiziert diese        .
Dann bin ich bereit meine Meinung zu revidieren.

Die halbwegs glaubhaften Bewertungen bekommt man nur wenn man Sterneverteilung je nach Bewertungsquelle auf Organisch stellt.
Das wäre bei TrustPilot 53% Ungenügend und 31% Hervorragend.

Dazu mehr auf

In the end the retailer gave me a full refund for failure to deliver plants in the promised nursery fresh condition. The plants did eventually arrive and the retailer said we could keep them.

I was today finalising a decision about the purchase of a home security system and had decided for a DIY installation of Arlo products.  These have received excellent reviews from reputable sources and the retailer I selected had a substantial majority of five star reviews.  There were some poor reviews mainly critical of the support.

It is sad to say I could only find three very unsatisfactory reports on TrustPilot and these were incorrectly placed in Arlo dk.  Arlo dk is a Scenic Designer and not a home security manufacturer or distributor.  No fast and easy way on Trust Pilot to inform moderators of the incorrectly placed reviews that could be prejudicial to the reputation of a well run business!

I could not find a Trust Pilot listing or reviews for Arlo Europe who would be the source of my proposed equipment.

I did find however that they had excellent support pages that were in conflict with criticisms I had read about after purchase service.   It would certainly be more helpful to readers if I was able to insert a link to that support page. Fully redacted link!!!!!!!
When attempting to write a first review for Arlo Europe the website link I inserted was not recognised.
That link provided extremely useful information that Arlo Ireland were now associated with Verisure!

My goodness what a circle - see my review of Verisure! 

I was put off from buying a very competitively priced set of equipment from Verisure because of the subscription (£35 month) and if the subscription was discontinued the equipment would have been severely restricted in its future use.

My purchase of two floodlight battery powered cameras with solar panels power plus a camera doorbell system are more expensive than a package deal from Verisure.

The standalone facilities of the Arlo products would seem to meet our basic needs and we will need to see what if any add on subscriptions we need to pay!

Over to you TrustPilot

Title: Negative and poor for new businesses
Text:
I was really eager to build a profile on TrustPilot but was so disappointed when, as a new business, you add seven 3.5 star reviews by default. Do even though I had a 5 star review my overall score was 3.5. I calculated that I'd need c.45 five star reviews before I would achieve your 5 star rating. I think you assume people are too dumb to appreciate that someone with one 5 star review doesn't have the credibility that some with a hundred 5 stars reviews might have. This works for Amazon, eBay ... all the well known on-line marketplaces that use customer ratings.
So, because I felt your scoring would negatively and unjustly impact the profile of my new business I have left TrustPilot and have instead started using Google to capture my customer reviews. By contrast to yourselves I now have five 5 star reviews and I have a 5 star (from 5 reviews) profile which makes perfect sense. Had that been on TrustPilot my score would be just 4.1.

Title: Supernöjd + har en idé till trustpilot
Text:
Mitt andra omdöme nu när det gått en hel del tid sedan förra. Jag vill säga att jag tycker trustpilot är en fantastisk tjänst. (Enda minuset fast inte deras fel är folk som uppenbart skriver fejk reviews eller skriver rasistiska saker mm. ) Jag och min man har besparat oss flertalet dåliga köp och tjänster. Dock glömmer man ibland tyvärr bort trustpilot och köper nåt och sedan bittert ångrar sig för att företaget visar sig vara väldigt dåligt. Därför har jag ett önskemål jag hoppas trustpilot vill fixa: jag tänker att man kunde utveckla ett webbläsar-tillägg som man kan installera på olika webbläsare och både mobiler och datorer och allt där emellan. Sen skulle man kunna ställa in den att tillåta att scanna igenom trustpilot för den sida man besöker så att när man kommer in på en sida så kommer det en popp upp där det står typ att trustpilot hittade denna sida bland sina omdömen och betyget är xxx och klicka här om du vill läsa mer eller klicka har för att stänga och gå vidare till sidan. Sen kanske man även kan klicka ”visa inte denna sidas betyg igen” ifall man inte vill ha en popup fler gånger . Jag tänker att då skulle man aldrig någonsin glömma att kolla trustpilot först. Det hade varit så bra. 

Synd bara dock att trustpilot behövs. Det är så synd att så otroligt många människor blir lurade och behöver skriva här och synd att konsumenterna ska känna sig ”tvungna” att kolla upp företag först. Man vill ju gärna tänka att ingen skulle vilja luras. Sen är ju även trustpilot för sådana som varmt rekommenderar någon så det är ju bra - men ändå - lite samma känsla trots allt - att det är synd att det behövs. Hursomhelst: jag tycker verkligen bra om trustpilot och kan väl egentligen bara hoppas komma ihåg att själv kolla hos dem innan man handlar.

If I do "claim my business", Trustpilot will display all my personal details for everyone to see. What happened to data protection?
I run a very small business and do not have a meaningless head office address. Therefore I do not wish to display my personal details all over the internet. Title: I have concerns about Trustpilot's impartiality
Text:
Trustpilot has now removed all my reviews justifiably and objectively critical of the courier Hermes claiming that its "advanced software" has detected "suspicious activity". Even when I supplied the requested evidence to support my last review it wasn't reinstated. Yet similarly critical reviews of two other couriers, DPD and Yodel, which actually took the trouble to respond when Hermes hasn't, remain on Trustpilot. What was "suspicious" about this review for example: 

"If Hermes UK was rated on how its appalling "customer services" performs when things go wrong it would be lucky to rate a single star.

Once again a parcel sent to me by an ebay seller has reached the company's Plymouth depot but several days later still hasn't been passed to the delivery driver and is probably "lost". The last tracking event on 4 May informed me of a delay of 48 hours but on 10 May there has been no update. To make matters worse, Horrible Holly obstructs my enquiry about the delay being passed to a real person and merely repeats the tracking message.

I have no complaints about my local Hermes delivery driver but I have experienced problems with all other aspects of the company's delivery service and I now use Royal Mail to send items I've sold on ebay.

UPDATE: Much to my surprise the parcel arrived on 14 May, equalling Hermes' record of nine days delay for a parcel delivered to me. The tracking provided no clue about where it had been."

Excuse me for being suspicious that Trustpilot has succumbed to pressure from Hermes to remove and discourage critical reviews. I cannot believe that a company like Hermes, whose appalling performance has featured on BBC's 'Watchdog' and whose dissatisfied customers are being assisted by Consumer Action in legal action, has such a high Trustpilot rating. I now have concerns about Trustpilot's impartiality.

Thanks for your response Hayley but it does not explain why your "advanced software" deemed the critical review I quoted to be "suspicious". Perhaps Trustpilot should monitor if the software is removing very valid critical reviews, giving companies like Hermes an undeserved and misleading high rating. Having seen how it removed my reviews I find it difficult to trust Trustpilot.

Trustpilot has now removed another totally objective and reasonable review critical of Hermes UK. Even if this isn't the result of pressure from the company there is something seriously wrong with the "advanced software" that removes these reviews and that undermines trust in Trustpilot. Citizens Advice has published a report 'Sorry we missed you' containing the results of a survey exposing the failings in the delivery industry and calling for delivery firms to be penalised for their failings as the Royal Mail is. Contrast that with the positive reviews Trustpilot allows whilst removing critical reviews.

Title: Don’t trust the reviews on Trustpilot
Text: For a company based on the values of trust and transparency sadly they are anything but. I’ve shopped in two online websites known for extremely poor and borderline fraudulent practices (no customer replies, missing packages, refusal to issue refunds and returns, deleting complaints on social media) and with poor reviews everywhere apart from Trustpilot where suspiciously, the bad reviews are covered by pages and pages of spam positive “reviews” that read like ads. The worst experience I’ve had was writing a genuine negative review for one of these stores for ghosting me and refusing to respond after failing to deliver my order. Trustpilot subsequently takes down my authentic review, tags it as spam (!!) and demands proof of purchase. I provide all evidence including receipts and unanswered emails from the company and despite following up Trustpilot never responded, nor had they reversed the deletion of my review. I would never trust the ratings on Trustpilot as they seem to encourage fraudulent reviews, look elsewhere.

Title: Wie ich schon richtig vermutet habe,
Text:
Wie ich schon richtig vermutet habe,

„Trustpilot“ hat mal wieder, nur im Januar, für seinen V.I.P.-Kunden „TotalAV“, 9 von 13 Negativbewertungen gelöscht, aber mindestens 126 eindeutig ersichtliche positive Fake-Bewertungen zugelassen. Beim ständigen beobachten der Bewertungen kann man auch feststellen, dass von den negative Bewertungen nach und nach immer mehr verschwinden und positive Fake-Bewertungen vermehrt zunehmen, alle auf Einladung. Eigenartiger Weise haben diese angeblichen Kunden alle samt nur insgesamt ein oder zwei Bewertungen auf „Trustpilot“ gepostet, wo sich auch periodisch diese sinnfreien Ein- oder Zweizeiler, eben nur mit anderen Accounts ständig wiederholen. Weiterhin ist sehr auffällig, nach jeder Negativbewertung folgen noch am selben Tag, außer am Wochenende oder internationalen Feiertagen gleich mehrere positive Fake-Bewertungen (ist schon irgendwie merkwürdig), so das die Negativbewertungen schnellst möglich im „Untergrund“ verschwinden, auch bei den Negativbewertungen zu „Trustpilot“ ist diese Masche wohl Standard!

Habe alle Negativbewertungen zu „TotalAV“ vom Januar gespeichert. Keine einzige der Negativbewertung verstieß gegen die Richtlinien von „Trustpilot“, es waren alles echte Käufererfahrungen von TotalAV-Kunden. Die Negativbewertungen zu „TotalAV“ kann ich auch bestätigen, da ich selbst fast in die Kostenfalle dieser Betrugs- und Abzock- Firma geraten wäre!

Wie ich schon in einer früheren Bewertung von mir zu „TotalAV“ geschrieben hatte, nur auf „Trustpilot“ hat diese Firma noch die Möglichkeit als V.I.P.-Kunde seine Bewertungen, gegenüber wirklich echten Bewertungsportalen zu manipulieren!

Meine persönlichen Favoriten der Textbausteine von „Trustpilot“ sind immer wieder:

- „Unternehmen können uns nicht zwingen, Bewertungen zu löschen, und jede Bewertung unterliegt denselben Standards und Richtlinien. Egal, ob ein Unternehmen Trustpilot bezahlt oder uns kostenlos nutzt, der Vorgang ist der gleiche.“

- „Sollten Sie Bedenken zu gefälschten Bewertungen haben, oder Ihnen Unregelmäßigkeiten auf unserer Plattform aufgefallen sind, können Sie diese gerne unserem Content Integrity-Team melden.“

- „Es würde uns freuen, wenn Sie sich diesbezüglich direkt an unser Content Integrity-Team wenden würden, da unser Team dazu Stellung nehmen kann.“

Ist ebenfalls total sinnfrei, da sowieso seitens „Trustpilot“ keine Antworten kommen und sich erst recht nichts ändert, wie z.B. auch bei „Opodo“, „1-2-3 tv“ und den vielen anderen unseriösen Firmen und Shops, die sich dann auf „Trustpilot“, natürlich gegen gute Bezahlung, wieder als seriöse Unternehmen oder Shops präsentieren können, weil diese auf echten Bewertungsportalen keine Möglichkeit zur Manipulation haben!

Title: Hier muss juristisch eingeschritten werden
Text:
Zitat der Trustpilot-Bewertung des Nutzers „Alen Herac“ über epicgames.com, datiert auf den 7. November 2021:

„Größte Schmutzentwickler, selbst RL haben sie komplett gefickt, Unfähige Spassten.“

Ich habe diese Beleidigung/Verleumdung Trustpilot vor einer Weile gemeldet, jedoch steht immer noch alles exakt so da. Will man die Bewertung nochmals bezüglich schädlicher/rechtswidriger Inhalte melden, vielleicht hatte man eine Prüfung nur vergessen, so heißt es beim aufklappenden Menü sofort:

„Wir haben bei einer früheren Prüfung bereits festgestellt, dass diese Bewertung keinen Verstoß aus diesem Grund gegen unsere Richtlinien darstellt.“

Menschen als „unfähige Spaßten“ (auch noch falsch geschrieben hatte der Typ dieses Wort) zu bezeichnen, verstößt also nicht gegen die Richtlinien von Trustpilot, interessant. Muss wohl richtig schön sein, sich auf seiner eigenen Webseite um jegliche Gesetze einen feuchten Dreck zu scheren. Doch da Epic Games wohl keinen kostenpflichtigen Trustpilot-Account besitzt, können die dagegen auch nicht vorgehen. Denn solange sie nicht das dicke Geld nach Dänemark, wo Trustpilot sitzt, für einen solchen Account schicken, wird Trustpilot auch nicht gegen diese Verleumdung, die bei einem in Deutschland ansässigen Unternehmen sofort den Straftatbestand von § 187 StGB (Verleumdung) erfüllen würde, vorgehen und bei der Meldung eines privaten Nutzers, wie mir, ebenfalls nicht. So kommt man heutzutage also zu Geld, ohne selbst einen großen Aufwand zu besitzen. Ganz ehrlich: Solch eine widerliche Vorgehensweise erwarte ich normalerweise allein von kriminellen Unternehmen, die sich mit irgendwelchen Fakeadressen auf den Weihnachtsinseln oder in anderweitig schwer erreichbaren Ländern verstecken.

Und noch etwas Interessantes: Selbst wenn man nicht über einen Account angemeldet ist, kann man hier ein jegliches Unternehmen einfach auf Trustpilot reinwerfen, indem man in die obige Suchenfunktion einfach die Webadresse einfügt und dann die Entertaste drückt, ich habe es selbst ausprobiert. Jedermann, der auf Trustpilot vorbeischaut, kann ein jedes Unternehmen und eine jede Webseite hier reinstellen, ohne irgendeine vorherige Anmeldung/Registrierung! Sodann ist das Unternehmen sofort auf Trustpilot auffindbar und kann von jedermann frei bewertet werden, völlig egal, ob es dies will oder nicht, während Mitarbeiter dieses betroffenen Unternehmens wohl, laut Trustpilot, akzeptieren müssen, von Nutzern wie Alen Herac als „unfähige Spaßten“ bezeichnet zu werden. Witzigerweise benötigt man für die Bewertungen selbst plötzlich einen Account, für das Einfügen von Unternehmen, die ohne ihr Wissen hier plötzlich auf dieser Plattform erscheinen, witzigerweise nicht. Und natürlich können sich die betroffenen Unternehmen erst wehren, wenn sie sich einen kostenpflichtigen Account besorgen, während hier andere Unternehmen dies gnadenlos ausnutzen und hier massenweise Fakebewertungen einstellen (z. B. Opodo oder 1-2-3.TV).

Ganz ehrlich: Das ist doch hier nicht mehr normal! Kann da nicht irgendjemand mal juristisch einschreiten, vielleicht über das EU-Recht?

PS: Meine hiesige Bewertung habe ich sicherheitshalber in einer Word-Datei abgespeichert, nur für den Fall, falls die hier plötzlich verschwinden sollte, da ich hier ganz offen die Fakten darlege.

Title: TrustPilot Gave My Email to a Spammer
Text:
*** About This Review ***

This review is 1 star higher than my previous review. Trustpilot is improving, but there is still a lot more room for improvement. This review is based on an experience I've had with Trustpilot in ticket #9885465.

*** Why This Review ***

I've received an email from Trustpilot with the following subject:

"Semalt would like some information regarding your review"

Now I've had zero engagement or relationship with the spammer Semalt (other than the relentless spam they send to my mail boxes). When I clicked on the link Trustpilot sent me, they asked for some information.

- reference number
- name
- phone number

I've refused to provide all of this information, because this information was not held by Semalt. Semalt and I do not have any relationship. I did however provide proof of their spam.

When I've submitted the form that Trustpilot told me to fill out, it provided my message (consisting of a lot of "I don't know semalt, they don't have this information, etc etc"), and in that list of information provided, Trustpilot included my email address, which was not supposed to be provided to Semalt.

This is highly concerning because:

1). I was not asked to provide an email address.
2). I did not voluntarily provide my email address.
3). There was no indication that Semalt would receive my email address after I submitted the form.

Obviously, this is a privacy concern. I'm not a lawyer, so I can't possibly determine if Trustpilot is in violatio n of their own privacy policy:

legal.trustpilot dot com/for-reviewers/end-user-privacy-terms

However I do feel this was inappropriately handled, and now Semalt has my email address, an address known only to Trustpilot. Thankfully, my email address is exclusive to Trustpilot. But the fact remains that they've provided MY email address to Semalt.

*** Possible Remedy ***

There is no full remedy to resolve the issue in this review, because the damage has already been done. The 2/5 stars will remain for now.

However, if Trustpilot could update the form that I've received so that one of the following would happen:

Option 1. Inform the submitter whether or not their Trustpilot account email address would be provided to the requester

OR

Option 2. Give the submitter the option to refuse the email address

OR

Option 3. Give the submitter the option to provide an email address that is different from the Trustpilot account email address

OR

Option 4. All of the above

I would be willing to update my review to 3/5 stars (and possibly 4/5 if Trustpilot thoroughly addresses this, and goes with "Option 4" in my suggestions.

I hate writing these types of reviews because they waste my time, and are embarrassing. Hopefully, Trustpilot reconsiders how they handle my private information when such information is requested by a real world spammer (Semalt). Look them up and you'll see what I mean.

And yes, I really am happy to update this review to a 4/5 star rating if Trustpilot can consider the simple request of letting people know if their email will be provided, and if they can have the choice of providing it. This I feel is highly reasonable.

Title: Write an Honest Review, and See it Removed
Text:
I have twice tried to leave an honest, respectful, and accurate negative review of a company that I believe to be operating a scam, only to have it flagged by TrustPilot's "advanced" software as being suspicious, and hence removed.

How is TrustPilot useful to consumers if negative reviews are not allowed to be seen? I am trying to help people avoid making the same mistake that I did by falling for a fake investment offer. 

What is really hilarious, is that I have read a multitude of reviews that are downright rude and include insults, swearing, and promotional content, but when I try to write an honest review, stating accurate facts, and using clear and respectful language, it is removed. 

Absolutely shocking and disgusting, leaving me with the conclusion that TrustPilot, as a consumer review site, cannot be trusted.

And your boilerplate response below is total BS, as my review contains none of the content you mention, but was still removed. I have now contacted your Content Integrity team and provided hard evidence that my review reflects my true experiences with the company concerned. But somehow I doubt that will make any difference and the time I spent writing the review will have been wasted. I see no point in contributing further reviews to TrustPilot, or to trusting it as an impartial consumer information resource.

I understand that their score may be bolstered both by past performance and their corporate membership of your service, but perhaps you would consider making the score more reflective of recent performance?

Text: In exchange for high fees ($500+ per month), TrustPilot.com rates certain companies highly by allowing fake reviews, while hurting the reputation of other companies that didn’t pay these high fees. By using this approach, the reviews appear to be real but are “paid reviews” and fake. Trustpilot’s member companies use sites like freelancer and fiverr  to hire freelancers to write fake reviews. Companies can buy fake reviews on these sites for as low as $5, making it extremely easy for TrustPilot’s partner companies to get hundreds of fake reviews that appear real!

The fact that this site doesn't remove reviews from their page which are clearly reviewing other companies just shows you how trustworthy they really are. They don't remove or edit genuine reviews, even when the reviewers made a mistake to Trustpilots own detriment. 

I've just had a look at another website called Judge.me, which are a similar principal to Trustpilot, and it's so clear that on their site companies can remove low reviews. That's obvious because Cloverwoo comes up at 5* on Judge.me and yet all the Trustpilot reviews of that company (and my own experience) rate it at 1.5*. I very much wish I'd checked the Trustpilot page before I purchased from Cloverwoo. 

Thank you Trustpilot for being a reliable source of genuine reviews. I'll be sure to check you before any future purchases online.

Title: Trustpilot complicit in companies gaming their system
Text: I had occasion to write a review about a covid testing company called Halo based at Heathrow. I saw that the reviews are highly skewed with a large number of 5s and a substantial number of 1s with not a lot inbetween. When you examine the 5s the vast majority are invited by the company whereas most of the 1s are organic which means that the customer did the review without being asked. What the company then does is object to a large proportion of 1s 2s or 3s and manages to get most of those removed. I suspect most are because have wasted enough time with Halo's poor service to reply to Trustpilot's request for more information. In contrast, no 5s are objected to. But here are dozens of 5s that are clearly fictional due to their shortness, poor English- all the signs that people who write about sites like Trust pilot say are evidence of fake reviews. I tried flagging these but as a customer you can only flag one for each of a small number of reasons. The result of all this is that Halo are managing, by gaming the system, to get a score of 4.3 when their real score would be less than 3. And Trustpilot seem to be complicit in it because they allow such shoddy practices. All this confirms my cynicism about sites like (lack of) Trustpilot - read the 1s and if there are loads of people who have had appalling service and lots of one liner 5s, then don't touch that company even if the overall score is over 4 because there is clearly a big distortion of performance going on. And I bet Trustpilot will find a way of removing this review without addressing the issue.

Title: Penge eller troværdighed!
Text:
Kære Peter Holten Mühlmann,
Jeg skriver denne anmeldelse med kun en enkel ufortjent stjerne, og håber på, at en af dine medarbejder læser den og drøfter sagen (principiel sag) med dig, således at Trustpilot (TP) enten beholder den ene stjerne eller får fem stjerner. Kort sagt:  jeg retter mig til det bedste argument.

Og nu til sagen: 
Jeg har haft nogle meget ubehagelige oplevelser med en virksomhed. Derfor skrev jeg et par anmeldelser på TP. Men virksomheden har i sit svar oplyste mit fulde navn her på TP. Jeg skrev til virksomheden, at de straks skulle slette mine personoplysninger, med det ville de ikke, så Trustpilot ordnede sagen for mig, og jeg blev rigtig glad.
Men nu har virksomheden valgt at rapportere mine anmeldelser gennem TP og påstår, at jeg ikke respekterer virksomhedens privatliv og har inkluderet deres oplysninger i mine anmeldelser.
Men jeg er meget uenig, da en virksomhed (juridisk person) med et CVR.nr. IKKE er beskyttet af GDPR, ej heller ikke af TP’s retningslinjer. GDPR regulerer IKKE oplysninger om virksomheder eller andre juridiske enheder.
Jeg har i øvrigt ikke oplyst virksomhedens ansattes fulde navn, og kun oplyst de initialer som virksomheden selv har oplyst på nettet og de sociale medier.
Jeg ved faktisk ikke om en af dine medarbejder ved navn Isabella H. er en robot eller en fysisk person, da hun copy&paster og sender mig det samme svar, samt et link til TP’s retningslinjer igen og igen, selv om jeg oplyser, at have læst TP’s retningslinjer grundigt.

Jeg skriver også, at hvis virksomheden skriver til mig direkte eller gennem Trustpilot og fortæller, at de ikke længere har personerne ansat i virksomheden så ville jeg naturligvis få slettet navnene.

Derfor mener jeg, at Trustpilot uberettiget har sat mine anmeldelser offline.
Jeg har argumenteret sagen yderligere med Isabella H. via e-mailkorrespondancen, men hun vil slet ikke besvare mine spørgsmål.
Meget utroværdigt, synes jeg.

Une honte ce site. A la botte des entreprises.  Mon avis sur une entreprise de vélo m'a été retiré car il nuisait à limage de l'entreprise. L'entreprise et trustpilot ont fait pression pour que je retire mon avis, en disant que je ne faisais pas parti du club. J'ai donc envoyé un autre avis , bidon celui-là, avec 5 étoiles et que des arguments positifs. Là je reçois 2 semaines après un message de trustpilot me félicitant car mon avis avait été vu 28 fois. Il n'y avait plus de problème de faire parti du " club" bizarrement.  Jai donc laissé les 5 étoiles mais remis mes commentaires negatifs sur ce vélo et là trustpilot a purement et simplement supprimé mon avis.

Title: THINK I'VE NOW LOST ALL TRUST AND CONFIDENCE IN TRUSTPILOT!
Text: Visited Trustpilot's website today to get advice about how to deal with a business that has 'flagged' one of my reviews under the heading of 'harmful or illegal' content. I devoted a lot of time, care and attention to writing this review, as I have done regarding all my reviews on Trustpilot, to give a fair, honest, truthful and reasoned account with full evidence quoted in support, as all my reviews, as I definitely think that should be the responsibility of reviewers leaving reviews on this platform. I had come here because having excercised such responsibility anyway, I could not see any justified reason behind 'flagging' my review. It turns out reading the articles on Trustpilot's website, that businesses can, as appears otherwise to me to be the only outward available reason in this case, 'flag' a review under the heading of 'harmful or illegal', and the review can be removed by Trustpilot, if the business feels resulting harm may be caused to the business in consequence of the review. There obviously is no point whatsoever writing and leaving any review on Trustpilot if Trustpilot thinks, according to its rules, that a company's financial or other interests, apparently as in this case as there appears to be no other valid reason, should supercede the interests of, in all respects otherwise, fair, accurate and truthful representation, as that obviously is not ethical, and means nobody can rely on the validity of reviews posted here if you remove such reviews that businesses don't like and want you to remove! I think by now you seem to have lost all credibility as a fair and equitable organization; against that is the fact that yours is the only review site of its type I have heard of, so if you did not exist there would be nowhere otherwise to leave consumer reviews at all, but obviously another site more concerned about accurate and truthful representation over and above financial or other commercial interests is obviously needed now to try to achieve fair play, as I also don't think Trustpilot should be censoring such reviews anyway to avoid otherwise unnecessary ethical and credibility issues like these on the part of Trustpilot! I have come to realize Trustpilot is not the fair, open and equitable organisation I thought it was when I joined Trustpilot a couple of years ago, but unfortunately there doesn't seem anywhere else to go instead as I have alluded to above!

Title: Guter Ansatz, leider mit Kontroll-Lücke!
Text:
Ich habe u.A. aufgrund einer guten Gesamtbewertung auf Trustpilot (4 von 5 Sternen) das Dating-Portal MyDates.com in Anspruch genommen, über das man mithilfe von bezahlten Chats in Kontakt zu Damen aus der Region treten kann. Leider hat sich herausgestellt, dass es sich bei den Chatpartnerinnen um bezahlte Animateure handelt, die nur dafür sorgen sollen, dass man kostenpflichtige Nachrichten mit ihnen austauscht. 

Sehr viele Nutzer haben diese Erfahrung mit 1-Stern-Bewertungen dokumentiert, trotzdem wird das Dating-Portal auf Trustpilot kontinuierlich mit  "Hervorragend"-Bewertungen geflutet, so dass es trotzdem eine 4-Stern Gesamtbewertung bekommt, auf die man sich bei oberflächlicher Prüfung gerne verlässt. Wie kommt das? Wenn man sich die 5-Stern-Bewertungen genauer anschaut, sieht man folgendes:

1. Die 5-Stern Bewertungen sind rund zur Hälfte auf Einladung erfolgt, und das, obwohl das Dating-Portal gar nicht dazu auffordert.
2. Umgekehrt haben 100% der Einladungs-Bewertungen 5-Sterne, was sehr unwahrscheinlich ist.
3. Einige der eingeladenen Bewerter haben noch viele andere Bewertungen vorgenommen, die ebenfalls 5-Stern sind, teilweise sogar mehrere Dating-Portale am selben Tag, mit Kommentaren wie "habe die Liebe meines Lebens gefunden"...

All diese Hinweise sprechen dafür, dass dort nicht "normale" Menschen ihre Erfahrungen teilen, sondern bezahlte Bewerter ihre Listen abarbeiten. Und das ist meiner Meinung nach nur möglich, weil zur Anmeldung bei Trustpilot eine Mailadresse reicht, es erfolgt keinerlei Prüfung der angemeldeten Nutzer. Ich verstehe, dass Trustpilot die Schwelle für das Erfassen von Bewertungen bewusst niedrig halten möchte, aber das wird zum Bumerang, der den Trust zersetzt. Aus diesem Grunde leider nur 3 Sterne.

Morale della favola, la contraddizione è più che evidente. Gentile Sara, ti invito a confrontarti con Marco S del Content Integrity così magari evitate di rimpallarvi l'uno con l'altro. Dal canto mio, farò quanto più posso affinché questa storia d'ipocriisa venga resa più nota possibile!

Text:
I recently left a 1 star review about an awful utility company who I won't name (But rhymes with Mutilia) with poor customer service. I hoped sharing my experience of their poor customer service, i.e not picking up the phone and kicking me out of live chat because they lacked the people to man them, would help people in making an informed choice.

However, "Mutilia" got the 1 star review removed on the basis I couldn't provide documentation of unanswered calls or being kicked out of live chat. How on earth are you supposed to do that? What documentation? 

So, my feeling is that TrustPilot does what the companies say in the name of "authenticity", but actually, all it does is create the illusion bad companies are beloved by the people.

Title: ALERTE -ESCROQUERIE FINOMARKETS
Text:
ALERTE -ESCROQUERIE FINOMARKETS
investigations menées par un proche sur les manœuvres d'escroquerie.
Les premières approches sont mielleuses pour mettre en confiance. Le 1° versement enregistré, vous n'avez plus le contrôle de l'algorithme.
On est incité à mettre plus, et on vous propose des contrats sur comptes GAFAM falsifiés - c'est la spécialité de JENSEN-(Apple, Amazon GOOGLE, etc..., s) pour trader sur un courte période( 21 jours).
Aucune somme n'est versée dans des établissements financiers. C'est très grave.
Les versements sont faits sur des entreprises écrans au capital de 100 euros. En allant sur google, on peut voir les photos de ces boutiques à la simple façade de misère: Algoritmo Basico Unipessoal . Ce n'est pas un établissement  financier, mais une entreprise d'activités de programmation informatique.
A l'issue du contrat, on vous envoie le document volé et falsifié de ASTRA AMCO, qui vous donne le détail des profits et de la taxe à payer
Le paiement des taxes est fait chez Fabulas Pomposas Unipessoal qui est une entreprise d'études de Marchés et sondage d'opinion chez Banco Novo et non pas sur un etablissement financier dédié.
Alors, là, méfiance. On vous dit que la somme a été mal imputée et qu'il faut reverser les taxes sur LEADORIUM OU qui est une entreprise de publicités, relations publiques et services liés à l'industrie. Encore une fois, ça n'a rien à voir avec un établissement financier dédié.
On a donc payer 2 fois la taxe.
On vous demande d'envoyer des selfies pour voir si vous êtes la bonne personne et que ce n'est pas du blanchiment d'argent.
Le virement total vous est annoncé par un document bancaire falsifié de UNICREDIT BANK à PRAGUE.
ET bien sûr, le virement n'arrive jamais.
Pour ce qui me concerne, j'attends la réponse de cette banque pour information.
Ces escrocs ne se manifestent plus, et ferment votre compte aussitôt et vous n'avez plus accès à rien.
Quand on appelle au n° 0032460216694, c'est une "nunuche" qui vous répond sans savoir ce qu'elle va vous dire, ne veut pas vous dire où se trouve FINOMARKETS, et vous raccroche au nez. Tous les autres n°s ne répondent plus.
Et voilà, comment on s'est fait voler notre argent.
Pour ceux qui doivent payer la taxe et qui ne le peuvent pas, surtout, ne donnez plus rien, sinon, ce sera 2 fois la taxe à payer et au final, vous n'aurez rien du tout.
La présentation de FINOMARKETS qui semble bien sous tous rapports est un grossier mensonge. Il n'y a pas de services de traitement des plaintes malgré ce qui est écrit, comme il n'y a pas de service clients et de conformité.
C'est une tromperie honteuse.
Les avis positifs proviennent des employés sous des noms d'emprunt et les réponses sont faites par leurs collègues.
TRUSTPILOT est manipulé aussi.
Je vous tiens au courant après une visio réunion lundi, avec ASTRA ASSET qui a été escroqué de sa licence et a vu ses documents officiels falsifiés.
Nous saurons si l'adresse en Angleterre est réelle.

Title: Negligent Company Allowing People to Leave Reviews to Wrong Companies in the Wrong Country and NOT FIXING IT in the same Amount of Time a Review Can Post a Wrong Review
Text:
Trustpilot allows reviewers to post reviews without verifying if they are reviewing the correct company. While it is fun to read bad reviews, it would be great if Trustpilot can verify the country, service and industry first before helping commit defamation. Maybe get the reviewer to go through a series of checks if the review being left is for the correct company. 

So far the probably legitimate review of Bruna Oliviera for a British company has been up for 13 hours on an Australian company that do not have any connections to each other.  Fix this Trustpilot. You're in the business of trust and this is ridiculous.

Update: so my business has to suffer a bad review over the weekend because a wrong review needs to go through a process? If it is so easy to post a review, you should give a wronged company the same ease in taking down an inaccurate review.

Update 2: after 14 hours, the review has been removed by the erring reviewer who did not exercise any due diligence. The Trust Score rating of 3.2 is still up on the drop down results after clicking search.  Why is this trust score not attached to the review when the review is deleted? 

A true test of a company is not just about providing a good service. It's score is also based on the speed they can fix a problem. To be told that there have to go through thousands of reviews daily so I have to wait is very much unacceptable especially when these things are online.  Do you know how fast things spread online?  Imagine leaving something up for over 14 hours.  Trustpilot, you are web-based so you speed is essential.

Update: Reply to Marina: Thank you for your reply. The drop down result is still stating my company has a 3.2 trust score from this errant woman's deleted review.
Just letting you know, I got involved in this ridiculous farce because one person, Bruna Oliveira, did not do her due diligence and posted a review that probably took a minute to write based on all the missing punctuations and misspellings. And now I have been dealing with this for 48 hours and have to wait for a further 48 hours?  Your integrity team needs to move as fast as the people you welcome to review on the platform you provided them.

Update: Trustpilot, thank you for your reply.  Your response still did not address my the issue of the Trustscore still sitting at 3.2 when Bruna Oliveira, the erring reviewer, has already removed her review and reposted it on to the correct company in the UK. You can insist on Trustpilot's commitment to honest reviews but this hasn't been fixed. I have reached out to both those support links you have provided since last Friday and nothing has been done to rectify the issue. I've sent the support team screenshots of what any person looking into finders keepers will see and your search results lists down 3 main companies with the same name with mine having "1 review" and "3.2 trust score" even though there is no review to base this on anymore.  Before you reply, I suggest you think about this and then honestly tell me why I should not be infuriated with this.  Remember, I got sucked into this because of an imbecile and then because your system is not updating the current information properly.

Title: Grâce à Truspilot, j’ai pu donner mon avis chez Yves Rocher!
Text:
Étant une fan incontournable des produits de beauté , j’avais envie de me faire un petit plaisir en commandant en ligne.
J’ai donc effectué ma commande sur le site internet d’Yves Rocher et ,comme d’habitude j’ai été satisfaite de ma commande! 
Je trouve ce magasin approprié à mes besoins. Les prix sont variables mais pas excessifs. Ça fait déjà quelques années que je connais et que j’utilise des produits de chez Yves Rocher. Il y à un large choix de produits , de maquillage, soins du corps,etc.. et il y en à pour tous les goûts! 
Il y a régulièrement des nouveautés , des promotions intéressantes. Ce que j’aime chez Yves Rocher c’est la carte de fidélité , celle-ci est vraiment personnalisée ce qui est vraiment bien. En fonction de nos goûts, de nos achats précédents, il nous est proposé divers produits que l’on est susceptible d’apprécier. 
On reçoit également un cadeau ou une belle promo à l’occasion de notre anniversaire, je trouve ça sympathique et touchant! 
A chaque achat une petits surprise nous attend c’est vraiment chouette ! On se sent gâtée et c’est ce qui m’attire  dans cette boutique. 
Il y à souvent beaucoup de monde, d’où son succès auprès des clients . Malheureusement ce n’est pas très grand en surface ,c’est le seul petit hic surtout lors des fêtes ou des supers promos on est un peu à l’étroit, mais ceci n’est qu’un détail bien sûr car ce qui compte vraiment est l’assortiment des produits et leur qualité! Concernant les  soins esthétiques qui nous sont proposé je n’ai pas encore eu l’occasion d’essayer mais cela ne saurait tarder!

Title: TrustPilot - det I lever af, burde I selv være gode til !!
Text:
Denne anmeldelses-"korrespondance med Olivia fra TP", har fået mig til at filosofere ift, Hvorfor man egtl bruger tid på at skrive en anmeldelse?

Ift. TP giver det vist mere mening, at vende dette om:
- For 1 ting, jeg tror der går igen, er at hvis man møder tilstrækkelig meget "mudder, kviksand og enerverende svar" - ja, så opgiver man blot firmaet.
- Og, det er nok hvad jeg vælger at gøre.

(dog: jeg afrunder, af respekt for mig selv, denne anmeldelse).

Jeg giver som sagt nok op, herefter .... bl.a. begrundet i det, der er sket her i dag:  Jeg har nu forsøgt at "komme ind til TP" med min anmeldelse - i 2 tilrettede / optimerede anmeldelses-redigeringer! (100% uden held! - se blot den TP-ansatte's svar).

Well .. jeg må gå ud fra, at Teknisk-Support, modtager tekniske henvendelser fra kunder - altså at de videresendes internt i TP - for dette sker i ethvert seriøst og velfungerende firma.

Jeg har således beskrevet såvel hvad der er sket, og hvad der triggede det skete - dvs. fejlen, og hvad der har forårsaget den!


Og, for en god ordens skyld - for det glemmes næsten - FEJLEN (som fører til en håbløs situation):
1) man får en anmeldelses-opfordrings-email fra et firma / en butik.
2) man klikker på linket - og det kan f.eks. være på toilettet, altså på ens mobiltlf (som det er blevet moderne at bruge alle steder, inkl. badeværelset).
3) Og, Enhedens standard-browser åbner så, og man kan anmelde.
4) Man anmelder - det går strygende ... alt imens at prutterne dufter herligt.
5) Man sender anmeldelsen, og tørrer sig - vasker hænder ... og går videre i ens hverdag.
6) Man får dog lige en email efter nogle sekunder, med tak for anmeldelsen (man har lige støttet TP og butikken).
...
7) Noget tid herefter, dumper der så en ny email ind - og den overrasker.
- for, i emailen står der noget med "Content-Check" (jeg husker ikke ordene) - og man informeres om, at anmeldelsen er DEAKTIVERET.
8) Og, Man bedes bevise, at der ikke er tale om snyd - og her kan man så vælge....
8A)  Hvis man vælger at "bevise" - og det har jeg gjort ca. 3 gange, i de seneste ca. 4 år, så starter en kæde af håbløse forhold ... bl.a. skal man forsøge at komme ind på den "sub-konto", som man kun kan komme ind på via anmeldelses-linket.  En vej, jeg hver gang har fortrudt, for den har ikke ført til andet end tidsspilde, i mit tilfælde.
8B)  Man sletter blot emailen, og tænker "firmaet klarer sig nok, uden min anmeldelse", eller "hvis det skal være så BØVLET at anmelde, så dropper jeg det".

og, 9)  Her kommer jeg så ind, som data-nørd:
10) for, jeg undersøger "hvorfor" det sker - og jeg skriver til Trustpilot, med det der ser ud til at være fejlen, eller som man kan gøre, for at undgå fejlen.
11)  Jeg anbefalede således TP at kræve "login" før man kan indsende en anmeldelse.
12)  Og, til det fik jeg så bl.a. svar på engelsk, generelle svar, og ... tjaee ... problemet er jo fortsat uløst!
...
13) Og, her er vi så.  Med det uheldige tal "13".  Og, der strander det hele så (i en uendelig "kviksands"-løkke, hvor man fokuserer på slutbrugeren (hvad laver han forkert!), fremfor at "se indad" og få løst fejlen).

"og Ja - de' er jo bar' dejligt"

Title: Engaño en Trustpilot, creo
Text:
Supongo que he mezclado valoraciones de Wallapop.. 
Contestan inmediatamente piden info adicional y a mí en dos ocasiones nunca dicen nada que no sean obviedades. Perdonen pero estoy harto, han ganado
Tengo una queja sobre TrusPilot,  si dejan que esas respuestas diletantes se publiquen, haganlo después de que la empresa responda, de otra manera son los cómplices de su gran excusa, que es cliente valora, empresa piden info+ inmediatamente. Es lo que consta. Cualquiera que lee piensa cliente pasa y se termina el caso. 
Uds me han ganado y se que no son fiables. 
Otra cosa que se es que he mezclado valoraciones. Mis disculpas y espero que la gente no descubra del lado que están. 
No señores otra tomadura de pelo Leo su enlace y no me imagino la razón, si es por alguna razón inconfesable, lo aceptó, supongo que tienen el derecho a retirar según que cosas, pero los clientes se merecen una respuesta que no sea copiar y pegar. Eso tiene un nombre arbitrariedad. Pero si nos acusan de ilegalidad o incumplimiento de sus normas. Nos merecemos que se tomen la molestia de decir el porque. Mirenselo. 

Cuando valoras una empresa, te piden información adicional, desde la empresa y a través de Trustpilot, creo que para que conste. Nunca han pasado de ese paso conmigo. Un engaño.

Title: Med fuldmagt fra min niece …
Text:
Med fuldmagt fra min niece ringede jeg til BOLIG-NET’s kundeservice omkring et urimeligt gebyr de havde påført hende.

Det lignede mest af alt bondefangeri og min oplevelse blev anmeldt på Trustpilot.

Via Trustpilot bad BOLIG-NET efterfølgende om yderligere oplysninger.

Dette blev videregivet umiddelbart efter deres anmodning.

Senere bad Trustpilot, tilsyneladende igen på opfordring af BOLIG-NET, om dokumentation for at der var tale om et “reelt” kundeforhold.

Dokumentation, som jeg kun kunne være i besidelse af med fuldmagt fra min niece, blev fremsendt, afvist og anmeldelsen slettet af Trustpilot.

Ny anmeldelse med samme formulering er nu lagt op på Trustpilot med niecen som bruger.

Lektien er, at du ikke kan anmelde noget eller nogen på vegne af en anden. Dette gælder også selv om du måtte være den der har haft den direkte kontakt og/eller kommunikation med den du anmelder.

Det står lidt kryptisk i Trustpilot’s betingelser men således fortolkes det altså.

Vil du på anmodning og med fuldmagt fra dit barn, niece og/eller bedstemor lave en anmeldelse, så kan den “forudrettede” få den fjernet.

Det står mere eller mindre klart under de betingelser som 99% af os nok ikke læser, det gjorde det også ved BOLIG-NET.

For mit vedkommende “blegner” Trustpilot’s fortolkning deres objektivitet og giver en ekstra “krølle” på din mulighed for, at afgive en fortjent kritisk vurdering.

Mon anmeldelsen var forlangt slettet af BOLIG-NET hvis de havde fået 5 stjerner ???

Dette er (igen) min egen reelle oplevelse … nu må vi se om den også bliver slettet ;-)

Title: Utroværdig Platform
Text:
Da Trustpilot i sin tid så dagens, var det en service, som løste et reelt behov hos forbrugerne især, og naturligvis også virksomheder. Dog er det blevet en meget utroværdig platform, da der er alt for mange opslag som slettes. Trustpilot skriver:

Virksomheder må ikke misbruge muligheden for at bede om dokumentation, f.eks. ved systematisk at bede om dokumentation for alle deres negative anmeldelser. Den slags adfærd er i strid med vores retningslinjer, og vi skrider til handling, hvis det finder sted.

Det er løgn. Trustpilot gør absolut intet, men please i stedet den virksomhed der måtte ønske det - hvilket egentlig godt kan forstås, da det er dem som betaler Truspilots lønninger. Det har taget overhånd i en sådan grad, hvor Trustpilot ikke har noget med trust at gøre. Interessekonflikten mellem virksomheden der betaler deres lønning og er hele deres eksistensgrundlad, er blevet for stor. Det er faktisk ærgerligt. Man kan håbe, at der en dag blomstrer et nyt Trustpilot op, hvor integriteten er i order, hvilket er det primære for denne type service.

Title: The worst experience ever, which is ironic...
Text:
A bit ironic that the company who aim to help businesses be more transparent, more customer friendly and deliver trust to prospects - instead deliver the worst ever customer experience so far in my whole life. 

We are now customers but will start implementing Google Reviews from now on to leave Trustpilot. The service and program it self is doing what it should, however the people ive been in contact with, is another story. Ive been in touch with accounting, salespeople and managers at TP and the bad service is throughout the whole chain of command. (except for 2 people, Eric and Sandra, whom tried to help) The biggest issue is that they just ignore emails, phone calls etc, dont mind getting back to you and hold different agreements. 

To give you some numbers: 8-10 weeks ago i emailed accounting - still today, no answer, including 6 follow up emails. (the issue is that our amount is wrong and we have a credit invoice) 

The other issue. We have two companies. The same settings and packages, but was offered two different prices from two different CSM. Difference over 20 000 SEK per year - we wanted the same deal on both accounts - took since may and 50 emails on - Hey, we want to buy this, can we continue? 

This could go on for pages and pages. My goal here is that someone at TP take a look at this, make a case study and improve the service for new clients. No one deserve this amount of bad service.

(UPDATE) 
After my review, i got the reply below. This is then the takeaway TP got from my review. 

1. I dont know where to find my CMS contact details?
- I´ve emailed and talked to my CMS for company 1, as well as the CMS for company 2, as well managers. On phone and email, several times. Still the issue was not solved and in between no one replied, why I hunted them down on the phone since the invoice payment period was ending. 

2. I dont know how to set up the accounts?
- Weve been customers with two companies for one year now, we are using the service. The issue was that we wanted to 1. Buy one more year but received two completely different prices for our two companies with same packages. Over 20 000 SEK in difference from two different CMS - How serious? 2. We wanted to merge the two contracts into one. 

The answer i got just make the whole thing even worse, suggesting (stupid) solutions like where to find contact details. Talk about missing the point here...

P.S Ive had support email on copy and emailed directly to that email as well, several times, never got a reply.  

Thanks Marina for the clear and helpful reply.

Title: Thank God for Trustpilot!
Text: While it's true that companies could pay people to post fake reviews for them on here, and I'm not sure how Trustpilot would be able to sort through what's real and what's fake (unless they have some sort of system in place that enables them to do so, and I just haven't read about it yet), I sincerely believe that this is the best website (besides BBB, but they don't seem to have much, if any, info on the majority of online retailers and possible scammers) to weed through who's legit and who's full of $#!+. Trustpilot has helped me navigate the increasingly difficult world of online shopping, which I do a lot, because not only do I live in rural Southeastern Indiana (and stores that carry higher quality products and more variety of products than, say, Walmart, are definitely not what you would call nearby), but also because I have a severe social anxiety disorder and rarely leave my house, anyways. So a big thank you to Trustpilot for being one of the only websites that try to help consumers like me sift through who's real, and who is basically just trying to steal your money. Which, btw, why isn't law enforcement taking more action on online scammers? It just seems to be just getting worse as time goes on. But thank God for Trustpilot! ❤️

Title: Occore monitorare.
Text:
Occore monitorare.
Su pagine come Ho Mobile e altri le recensioni sono fallate perchè aumentate da persone che inseriscono il codice amico e quindi inseriscono 5 stelle furbescamente.

Ho segnalato anche tantissime recensioni di VeryMobile contente i codici amico, ma in molti risulta che rispecchia i canoni di Trustpilot, mi sembra scorretto verso chi utilizza questa piattaforma per conoscere le recensioni reali e invece si ritrova una percentuale di gradimento non veritiera perchè furbetti cercano i 10 euro e 100 euro comunicando apertamente il loro codice.

Ho anche provveduto a segnalare seguendo il Vs consiglio.

Vi suggerisco di bloccare gli utenti che seguono il modus operandi dei codici amico, poichè vi sono alcuni che ciclicamente ripetono il messaggio, a volte rendono impossibile leggere altre recensioni perchè inseriscono tante di quelle righe bianche che diventa snervante leggere.

Quindi, se non si modificano queste situazioni, sconsiglio agli utenti di considerare Trustpilot come sito attendibile per le recensioni.
